title: What does a rice and wheat value tell us?
description: A scale from minus one hundred to plus one hundred shows the choice between rice and wheat in each state. The video reads Punjab's value of minus seventy eight and Bihar's value close to zero, and breaks Keeko's doubt that zero means no food.
teaching_notes: One idea: the sign says which grain is preferred and the distance from zero says how strongly. Watch for students who read a value of zero as nothing eaten.

source: On the scale, Punjab is -78 and Bihar is close to 0. What do
video_script.why: The child has seen the rice and wheat map but has not yet read what one value on its scale means.
video_script.substitution: Read the sign of a value for the preferred grain, and its distance from zero for how strong the preference is.
video_script.anchor: the book's infographic that maps the choice between rice and wheat in each state to values between minus one hundred and plus one hundred
video_script.wrong_answer: Bihar eats no rice and no wheat
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko reads a value close to zero as nothing eaten.
video_script.payoff_line: punjab strongly prefers wheat and bihar is about balanced

final_answer.value: Punjab strongly prefers wheat; Bihar is about balanced
final_answer.spoken: punjab strongly prefers wheat and bihar is about balanced

never_show: a value near zero means no rice and no wheat
maths_rules: the scale runs from -100 (wheat end) to +100 (rice end); each value comes from the difference between per capita rice and wheat consumption
a negative value means wheat is preferred; a positive value means rice is preferred
Punjab -78 is 78 steps from 0 and 100 - 78 = 22 steps from the wheat end at -100, so it leans strongly to wheat
a value near 0 means rice and wheat are eaten in about equal amounts, so Bihar is balanced
slip: +100 or -100 does not mean the other grain is not eaten at all, and 0 does not mean nothing is eaten
video_script.design: One idea: the sign gives the grain and the distance from zero gives the strength. The wrong idea is that zero means nothing eaten. A number line from minus one hundred to plus one hundred stays on screen all video.
